Finding.description: A source-linked claim: fact, inference, assumption or reported human input.

claim.description: The statement being made; its id is derived from this text.
claim.title: Claim

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that argues against the claim, kept so disagreement stays visible.
contradicting_evidence_ids.title: Contradicting Evidence Ids

created_at.description: When the record was first created (UTC), so history can be ordered and audited.
created_at.title: Created At

created_seq.description: Kernel-wide creation counter that orders records exactly where clock times tie.
created_seq.title: Created Seq

id.description: Identifier other records cite this one by; the kernel assigns it, or derives it from the content for evidence and findings.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Whether the claim is a source fact, an inference, an assumption or reported human input.

limitations.description: Caveats on the claim that the reader should weigh.
limitations.title: Limitations

producer.description: Who or what produced the finding, for audit.
producer.title: Producer

producer_version.description: Version of that producer (template or model), so findings can be compared across versions.
producer_version.title: Producer Version

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that backs the claim; a source fact must cite some.
supporting_evidence_ids.title: Supporting Evidence Ids

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC), so a reader can tell a stale copy from the current one.
updated_at.title: Updated At

Finding.title: Finding

agreements.description: Points on which the evidence sources agree.
agreements.title: Agreements

assumptions.description: Premises taken without evidence, listed so a reader can challenge them.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

constraints.description: Constraints the evidence puts on any option.
constraints.title: Constraints

disagreements.description: Points on which sources conflict; the decision keeps them as context rather than choosing.
disagreements.title: Disagreements

findings.description: Source-linked claims the synthesis reached, each citing its evidence.
findings.title: Findings

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

unknowns.description: What the evidence could not establish; the next research round aims queries at these.
unknowns.title: Unknowns
